criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: Messages are clear, complete and sent to the people who need them.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: No usable message was sent.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Messages were sent but unclear, late or missing key facts.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Messages were clear and reached the right people with the key facts.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Messages were concise, anticipated what the receiver needed and were confirmed.

criteria.name: Decision quality
criteria.description: Decisions fit the situation, the plan and the information available.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: No decision was made when one was needed.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A decision was made but the reasoning or the information used was thin.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The decision fit the situation and the plan, and the reasoning was stated.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: The decision weighed alternatives, named its risks and was revisited as facts changed.

criteria.name: Role clarity
criteria.description: The student acts within their role and knows what others own.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: Acted outside the role or waited to be told.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Role was partly understood; some tasks were missed or duplicated.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Acted within the role and handed off what belonged to others.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Acted within the role and helped others see where their roles met.

criteria.name: Use of plans
criteria.description: Plans, checklists and procedures are used and cited.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: Plans were not consulted.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Plans were consulted late or only when prompted.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The relevant plan or checklist was used and named.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Plans were used, and a gap or conflict in the plan was noticed and reported.

criteria.name: Situational awareness
criteria.description: The student tracks what has happened, what is happening and what may come next.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: Could not describe the current situation.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Described the situation but missed recent changes.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Gave an accurate, current picture of the situation.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Gave an accurate picture and anticipated the next likely developments.

criteria.name: Coordination
criteria.description: Roles share information and sequence their actions.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: Roles worked in isolation.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Some information was shared but actions overlapped or conflicted.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Roles shared information and sequenced actions without prompting.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Roles shared information, resolved conflicts quickly and kept one common picture.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: The team keeps messages clear and reaches the right people.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: Key people were not reached.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Messages reached key people with delay or gaps.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Messages were timely and complete.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Messages were timely, complete and confirmed by the receivers.

criteria.name: Decision quality
criteria.description: The team decides on time and with the information at hand.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: No team decision was made.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Decisions came late or without agreement.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Decisions were timely and the team agreed on them.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Decisions were timely, recorded and reviewed as the situation changed.

criteria.name: Observation quality
criteria.description: Observations are specific, tied to a task and free of opinion.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: No observations were recorded.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Observations were general or mixed fact with opinion.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Observations were specific, factual and tied to a task.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Observations were specific, factual, timed and tied to evidence the team could verify.

criteria.name: Coverage
criteria.description: The evaluator watched the tasks assigned to them.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: Most assigned tasks were not observed.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Some assigned tasks were observed.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Nearly all assigned tasks were observed.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: All assigned tasks were observed and gaps were reported.

criteria.name: Strengths and areas for improvement
criteria.description: Strengths and areas for improvement are stated so the team can act on them.

levels.label: Not shown
levels.descriptor: No strengths or areas for improvement.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Points were stated but vague.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Points were clear and tied to the observations.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Points were clear, tied to observations and suggested a next step.
